provenance.notes: ATR (Wilder, alpha 1/14) is 1 on the flat base. Entry 100.02, initial stop 2 ATR, trail 2 ATR from the best price. Candle 280 (doji: the worst-case path for the side, favourable extreme first) reaches 101.5: the trail moves the stop to 99.5000000 (best -/+ 2 x ATR(279) = 1); TR 1.5 lifts ATR(280) to 1.0357143. Candles 281-285 have zero range (TR 0), so the ATR of each closed candle shrinks by 1/14 and the level 2 ATR from the best rises (falls, short) at every candle-close decision: 99.4285714 (kept, behind the stop), 99.5765306 (kept: moves less than the 0.1 ATR minimum step), 99.7139213, 99.8414983, 99.9599627 (stop moved; price 100 still on the safe side), then with ATR(285) = 0.7150173 the level is 100.0699654: already THROUGH the price 100. No stop order can rest there (the exchange rejects it, -2021), so the bot closes at market at the next decision: the open of candle 286 (= its high, so the first path point is the open), 100 x 0.9998 = 99.98; the resting stop at 99.9599627 was never touched. i_out = 286, the candle of the fill (the trigger is the close of 285, the execution is a mark-time market order, not a candle-close exit). pnl = 5 x (-0.04) - 5 x 200 x 0.0005 = -0.7, R = -0.07. Code STOP_CROSSED: a taker close the BOT sent, not the exchange stop fill (STOP_HIT); the legacy backtester books the same price and bar as `stop`. No randomness: no seed is involved.
